passages.text: Then David conferred with all his leaders, the commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke with his leaders.
These leaders commanded groups of hundreds and thousands.
David asked advice from every commander.
passages.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֣ץ דָּוִ֗יד עִם־ שָׂרֵ֧י הָאֲלָפִ֛ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת לְכָל־ נָגִֽיד׃

passages.text: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to the whole assembly of Israel.
He said, “If you think this is good,
and if this is from the LORD our God,
let us send word to our remaining brothers in all the land of Israel.
Let us also send word to the priests and Levites.
The priests and Levites live in their cities and pasturelands.
Let them gather and join us.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְכֹ֣ל׀ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּמִן־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל־ אַחֵ֣ינוּ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּכֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְיִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Then let us bring back the ark of our God, for we did not inquire of Him in the days of Saul.”
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David spoke to the people of Israel.
David said, “Let us bring back the ark of our God to us.
We did not seek God during the days of Saul.”
passages.original: וְנָסֵ֛בָּה אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־ לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ בִּימֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: And because this proposal seemed right to all the people, the whole assembly agreed to it.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to all Israel.
He made a proposal to the people.
The proposal was to bring back the ark of God.
All the people heard David’s proposal.
The proposal seemed right to everyone.
The whole assembly agreed to do it.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ כָֽל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֑ן כִּֽי־ יָשַׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David gathered all the people of Israel.
He called people from the River Shihor in Egypt.
He called people up to Lebo-hamath.
David wanted to bring the ark of God.
The ark of God was in Kiriath-jearim.
David gathered the people to bring the ark from Kiriath-jearim.
passages.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־ שִׁיח֥וֹר מִצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־ לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִקִּרְיַ֖ת יְעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
All the people of Israel went with David.
They went up to Baalah in Judah.
Baalah is also called Kiriath-jearim.
They went there to bring the ark of God from that place.
The ark belongs to the LORD.
The LORD sits between the cherubim on the ark.
People call the ark by the Name of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֤יד וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔תָה אֶל־ קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִיהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵת֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ יְהוָ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שֵֽׁם׃

passages.text: So they carried the ark of God from the house of Abinadab on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding the cart.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David gathered all Israel to bring the ark of God to Jerusalem.
The ark of God was at the house of Abinadab.
They placed the ark of God on a new cart.
Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart.
passages.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֜יבוּ אֶת־ אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־ עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה מִבֵּ֖ית אֲבִינָדָ֑ב וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֔וֹ נֹהֲגִ֖ים בָּעֲגָלָֽה׃

passages.text: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
All the Israelites were with David.
They stood before God.
They celebrated with all their strength.
They sang songs.
They played harps.
They played lyres.
They played tambourines.
They played cymbals.
They played trumpets.
passages.original: וְדָוִ֣יד וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַׂחֲקִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּכָל־ עֹ֑ז וּבְשִׁירִ֤ים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֖יִם וּבַחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark, because the oxen had stumbled.
passages.sermon:
Uzzah was guiding the cart that carried the ark of God.
The ark of God was on a new cart.
They brought the ark from the house of Abinadab.
They came to the threshing floor of Chidon.
The oxen stumbled.
Uzzah reached out his hand.
Uzzah took hold of the ark.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת־ יָד֗וֹ לֶאֱחֹז֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אָר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃

passages.text: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Uzzah was an Israelite.
Uzzah reached out his hand and touched the ark.
The LORD became very angry with Uzzah.
The LORD struck Uzzah down because he touched the ark.
Uzzah died there in front of God.
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔א וַיַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ עַל־ הָאָר֑וֹן וַיָּ֥מָת שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah; so he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David saw what happened to Uzzah.
The LORD became angry with Uzzah.
The LORD struck Uzzah down.
David became angry because the LORD had burst out against Uzzah.
David gave a name to that place.
He called the place Perez-uzzah.
People still call it Perez-uzzah today.
passages.original: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔יד כִּֽי־ פָרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑א וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔א עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: That day David feared God and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”
passages.sermon: David was the king of Israel.\r\nOn that day, David feared God.\r\nDavid said, “How can I bring the ark of God to me?”
passages.original: וַיִּירָ֤א דָוִיד֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֚יךְ אָבִ֣יא אֵלַ֔י אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: So he did not move the ark with him to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David did not bring the ark of God to himself in the City of David.
David took the ark aside.
David placed the ark in the house of Obed-edom.
Obed-edom was a Gittite.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת־ הָאָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּטֵּ֕הוּ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־ אֱדֹ֖ם הַגִּתִּֽי׃

passages.text: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he owned.
passages.sermon:
The ark of God stayed in the house of Obed-edom.
Obed-edom and his family kept the ark in their home for three months.
The LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom.
The LORD also blessed everything that belonged to Obed-edom.
passages.original: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־ בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּבֵית֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־ אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃פ
